newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK EDRASIS INVESTED 1.3BLH DRS IN MACHINERY IN 96.
newsitem.headline: GREEK EDRASIS INVESTED 1.3BLH DRS IN MACHINERY IN 96.

text.p: Greek construction company Edrasis Psallidas which specialises in foundation works invested 1.3 billion drachmas in machinery in 1996, said its assistant financial manager.
"We invested a further 0.4 billion drachmas in fixed assets in 1996," Xenofon Avlonitis, the company's assistant financial manager told Reuters.
Edrafor, its subsidiary in Lebanon, had revenues of $3.0 million in 1996, he added.
Edrafor was founded in 1995, said Avlonitis. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
